claims.claim: OpenAI filed a countersuit against Apple on Friday in a California court, accusing Apple of stealing trade secrets and threatening suppliers.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI filed Friday in a California court, accusing Apple of stealing trade secrets
claims.source_title: OpenAI countersues Apple, alleging trade secret theft and supplier threats; Apple responds
claims.supporting_quote: The ChatGPT maker filed the lawsuit in a California court on Friday, striking back after the iPhone maker accused the AI lab of stealing top-secret information this summer.

claims.claim: OpenAI alleges Apple is coercing and threatening suppliers that work with both companies.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI accuses Apple of coercing and threatening suppliers that work with both companies
claims.source_title: OpenAI countersues Apple for stealing trade secrets
claims.supporting_quote: The ChatGPT maker also accuses the tech giant of ‘coercing and threatening’ suppliers who work with both companies, as legal battle escalates

claims.claim: Bloomberg reports OpenAI accuses Apple of undermining supplier relationships and using unfair employment agreements to stop talent leaving.
claims.episode_span: the complaint also alleges unfair employment agreements meant to keep talent from leaving
claims.source_title: OpenAI Says Apple Pressured Suppliers to Shun Its Devices
claims.supporting_quote: the artificial intelligence company accusing the iPhone maker of undermining its supplier relationships and using unfair employment agreements to prevent talent from jumping ship.

claims.claim: Apple's original suit names OpenAI, io Products, Chang Liu, and Tang Tan, and trial is set for July 19, 2027.
claims.episode_span: The original case is scheduled for trial on July 19, 2027.
claims.source_title: OpenAI countersues Apple, alleging trade secret theft and supplier threats; Apple responds
claims.supporting_quote: Apple’s original case is scheduled to go to trial on July 19, 2027 .

claims.claim: OpenAI says an employee who returned to Apple sent more than 100 confidential hardware files to personal accounts.
claims.episode_span: an employee who returned to Apple in October sent more than 100 confidential files
claims.source_title: OpenAI countersues Apple, alleging trade secret theft and supplier threats; Apple responds
claims.supporting_quote: The new action also follows OpenAI’s October claim that an employee who returned to Apple sent more than 100 confidential files about unreleased OpenAI hardware to personal accounts.

claims.claim: Apple said its counterclaims are a distraction and that OpenAI has already been ordered to stop using Apple confidential information.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI has already been ordered to stop using Apple's confidential information.
claims.source_title: OpenAI countersues Apple, alleging trade secret theft and supplier threats; Apple responds
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI’s counterclaims are a transparent attempt to distract from the substance of Apple’s lawsuit, in which OpenAI has already been ordered to stop using Apple’s confidential information.

claims.claim: Chile's FNE filed an antitrust lawsuit accusing Apple of abusing dominance in iOS app distribution and in-app purchases, with a potential $80 million fine reported.
claims.episode_span: a potential eighty-million-dollar fine and an App Store overhaul
claims.source_title: Apple faces potential $80 million fine and App Store overhaul in Chile
claims.supporting_quote: Chile’s national competition authority, Fiscalía Nacional Económica (FNE), has filed an antitrust lawsuit against Apple, accusing the company of abusing its dominant position in iOS app distribution and in-app purchases.

claims.claim: Waystar is integrating AltitudeAI and eligibility checks into Gemini for Healthcare, unveiled November 10, 2026, and says early adopters cut analysis time by up to 75 percent.
claims.episode_span: cut time spent analyzing complex claims and payer-payment datasets by up to 75 percent
claims.source_title: Waystar Integrates Revenue Cycle Intelligence With Google Cloud’s Gemini for Healthcare
claims.supporting_quote: According to Waystar, early-adopter provider organizations have reduced the time spent analyzing complex claims and payer payment datasets by up to 75% using its conversational analytics capabilities.

claims.claim: An Ontario tribunal ruled Amazon discriminated against a Toronto engineer because of Iranian citizenship under a policy barring some Iranian citizens from encrypted-technology jobs.
claims.episode_span: Amazon discriminated against a Toronto engineer because of his Iranian citizenship
claims.source_title: Amazon discriminated against Iranian job candidate under global hiring policy, Ontario tribunal rules
claims.supporting_quote: An Ontario tribunal ruled that Amazon discriminated against a Toronto engineer because of his Iranian citizenship.

claims.claim: Sensor Tower figures cited by ThePrint put ChatGPT at 330 million monthly users in India in May 2026 and Gemini at 229 million.
claims.episode_span: ChatGPT at 330 million monthly users in India in May 2026, against Gemini's 229 million
claims.source_title: New Google ad takes a dig at ChatGPT—Chatty Chetan vs Gemini Jai
claims.supporting_quote: In India, ChatGPT had 330 million monthly users in May 2026, compared with Gemini’s 229 million, according to Sensor Tower.

claims.claim: The Alexa Tablet 12 Pro uses a Dimensity 8400, with an 8GB/128GB configuration reviewed, a $500 base price, and Black Friday pricing of $400 for 128GB models.
claims.episode_span: both 128GB versions at 400 dollars for Black Friday
claims.source_title: Amazon’s Alexa Tablet 12 Pro Nanomatte hits $400, 9to5Toys reports
claims.supporting_quote: 9to5Toys lists both 128GB Alexa Tablet 12 Pro versions at $400 for Black Friday.

claims.claim: Australia passed a Digital Duty of Care law in late November 2026 imposing monitoring requirements and heavy fines, and EU regulators are urging AI Act investigations into Meta including nudifier-tool ads.
claims.episode_span: Australia passed its Digital Duty of Care law in late November 2026
claims.source_title: Meta Platforms (META) Faces Australia Monitoring Law And Fresh EU AI Probes
claims.supporting_quote: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) faces new regulatory pressure after Australia passed its Digital Duty of Care law in late November 2026.

claims.claim: The Information reports Trump and Vance backed Jensen Huang's return partly to protect open-source AI against closed-model firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
claims.episode_span: backed that return partly because they see him as critical to protecting open-source AI
claims.source_title: Trump, Vance Backed Nvidia's Jensen Huang Over Open-Source AI Concerns
claims.supporting_quote: Trump and Vance backed Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia partly because they see him as critical to protecting open-source AI.

claims.claim: Jassy said Amazon's AI business passed a $25 billion annualized run rate and is growing 440 times faster than early AWS, which was about $57 million after three years.
claims.source_title: Amazon’s AI business is growing 440x faster than early AWS, says Jassy
claims.supporting_quote: AWS reached an annualized revenue run rate of approximately $57 million after its own first three years.

claims.claim: AWS posted $46 billion in Q3 2026 revenue, up 39.3 percent, with a $578 billion backlog and a Jassy projection of more than $1 trillion within five to ten years, alongside about $220 billion of 2026 cash capex.
claims.episode_span: AWS posted 46 billion dollars of revenue in the third quarter of 2026, up 39.3 percent
claims.source_title: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy projects AWS could exceed $1 trillion in annual revenue
claims.supporting_quote: AWS brought in $46 billion in revenue for Q3 2026. That figure was up 39% year-over-year.
